info.title: mail-rocket-api
info.description: API for Mail Rocket: organizations, users, addresses, contact details, campaigns, groups, and recipients.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Password-based signup/signin. The only endpoints that don't require an Authorization header.

tags.name: Organizations
tags.description: Tenants. Every other resource is scoped to one organization.

tags.name: Addresses
tags.description: Postal addresses belonging to an organization and/or a user.

tags.name: Contact Details
tags.description: Email/phone contact info belonging to an organization and/or a user.

tags.name: Campaigns
tags.description: Email campaigns run by an organization.

tags.name: Templates
tags.description: Reusable HTML content for a campaign email.

tags.name: Identities
tags.description: Domains/email addresses an organization sends from.

post.description: Creates a new standalone user account, with no organization membership yet - add one via `POST /organizations/{organization_id}/users` or `PATCH /organizations/{organization_id}/users/{user_id}`.

get.description: Lists the organizations a user belongs to, each combined with the role they hold there.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of rows to return. Defaults to 10 if omitted.

patch.description: Updates a member's role (or membership metadata) within the organization. Does not touch the user's own profile fields - see `PATCH /users/{id}` for that.

400.description: A required path parameter is missing.

404.description: The user isn't a member of the organization.

delete.description: Removes a user from the organization by deleting their membership row. The user's account itself is untouched - see `DELETE /users/{id}` to delete the account entirely.

400.description: A required path parameter is missing.

404.description: The user isn't a member of the organization.

Organization.description: A tenant in Mail Rocket. Every other resource is scoped to one organization.

entity.description: Denotes the type of object and the domain it belongs to.

User.description: A user's identity, independent of any organization - see Member/OrganizationMembership for which organizations they belong to and their role in each.

email.description: Login identity. Never includes the password hash.

AuthSignup.description: Creates credentials for an email - either a brand new account, or (if the email belongs to a user invited by an org admin but never activated) attaches a password to that existing row.

token.description: JWT to send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on subsequent requests.

Address.description: A postal address belonging to an organization and/or a user.

is_primary.description: Whether this is the primary address of the organization.

user_id.description: Optional user to associate the address with.

ContactDetails.description: Email/phone contact info reachable via a user or an organization.

user_id.description: Optional user to associate the contact detail with.

Campaign.description: An email campaign run by an organization.

subject.description: Subject line of the campaign email.

logo_key.description: Storage key/path of the campaign logo.

logo_bucket.description: Storage bucket where the campaign logo is stored.

organizer_id.description: ID of the user organizing the campaign.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the campaign. Defaults to "draft" if omitted.

Group.description: A recipient list within a campaign.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign the group belongs to.

creator_id.description: ID of the user who created the group.

Template.description: Reusable HTML content for a campaign email. Subject/name for the send itself live on Campaign - a template only carries the body markup.

html_body.description: HTML markup of the email body.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign the template belongs to.

Recipient.description: A person targeted by a campaign/group.

Identity.description: A domain or email address an organization sends from.

type.description: Whether this identity is a domain or an email address.

identity.description: The domain name or email address being identified.

type.description: Whether this identity is a domain or an email address.

identity.description: The domain name or email address being identified.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the identity. Defaults to "created" if omitted.

type.description: Whether this identity is a domain or an email address.

identity.description: The domain name or email address being identified.

Membership.description: Grants a user membership (and a role) in an organization.

role.description: Permission level the user holds within this specific organization.

MembershipUpdate.description: Fields accepted when updating a membership (e.g. to change the user's role).

role.description: Permission level to grant the user within the organization.

MemberCreate.description: Fields for a new user, plus their initial role in the organization they're being added to.

role.description: Permission level to grant the user within the organization. Defaults to "viewer" if omitted.

Member.description: A user's profile fields combined with their role in one organization. `id` is the membership row's id; `user_id` is the user's own id.

role.description: Permission level of the user within this organization.

OrganizationMembership.description: An organization's fields combined with the role a user holds there. `id` is the membership row's id.

role.description: Permission level the user holds within this organization.

bearerAuth.description: Token returned by POST /auth/signup or POST /auth/signin.
